headline:
Strong rally,
valuation still reasonable
chart_note: 10-day range: $480.35 - $496.88. Roughly flat over the window after a mid-period dip and recovery.
why_today: Closed up 0.9% today, well above both its 20-day and 50-day averages - the month-long rally (+25%) is still intact.
pro_1: Earnings and revenue both growing double-digit year over year (+32% / +18%)
pro_2: Analyst sentiment strongly positive - the large majority rate it Buy or Strong Buy
con_1: Up roughly 25% in the past month alone - a lot of good news may already be priced in
con_2: Valuation isn't cheap at 27x trailing earnings, even if reasonable for the growth rate
